text.id: Atap rumah Sekar cuma dak beton dengan jemuran dan dua ember cat bekas yang dijadiin pot cabai. Dari sini, magrib kedengeran dari tiga masjid sekaligus, saling nyusul.
text.en: The roof of Sekar's house is just a concrete slab with a clothesline and two old paint buckets turned into chili pots. From up here, the call to prayer comes from three mosques at once, each one chasing the last.

text.id: Lo udah buka chatnya.
text.en: You opened the chat.

text.id: Kok tahu?
text.en: How'd you know?

text.id: Muka lo kayak orang abis nemu surat wasiat.
text.en: Your face looks like someone who just found a will.

text.id: Ka. Gue mau nanya sesuatu, dan gue mau lo jawab jujur. Kalian berantem soal apa, setahun lalu?
text.en: Ka. I want to ask you something, and I want an honest answer. What did you two fight about, a year ago?

text.id: Kak Sekar nggak pernah cerita. Dia cuma bilang, "Raka ngomong sesuatu yang bener, dan itu yang bikin sakit."
text.en: Sekar never told me. She just said, "Raka said something true, and that's what hurt."

text.id: Kak Sekar nggak pernah cerita. Dia cuma bilang, "Raka nggak ngomong apa-apa, dan itu yang bikin sakit."
text.en: Sekar never told me. She just said, "Raka didn't say anything, and that's what hurt."

text.id: Jawab Dinda.
text.en: Answer Dinda.

text.id: Ceritain semuanya. Termasuk bagian gue.
text.en: Tell her everything. Including my part.

text.id: "Gue pergi ke Bandung tanpa bilang. Itu aja."
text.en: "I left for Bandung without telling her. That's all."

text.id: Gue tarik napas. Udah setahun gue nggak ngomongin ini ke siapa pun.
text.en: I take a breath. I haven't said this out loud to anyone in a year.

text.id: Gue bilang dia bukan jurnalis. Bahwa dia cuma cewek yang punya mic.
text.en: I told her she wasn't a journalist. That she was just a girl with a mic.

text.id: Gue bilang nggak semua orang bisa hidup dari mimpi. Kayak mimpinya nggak penting.
text.en: I told her not everyone gets to live on dreams. Like her dream didn't matter.

text.id: Gue nggak bilang apa-apa. Dia minta gue ikut sekali aja, dan gue diem. Terus dia pergi.{w} Kadang diem itu lebih jahat.
text.en: I didn't say anything. She asked me to come just once, and I stayed quiet. Then she left.{w} Sometimes silence is worse.

text.id: Terus dia nunggu gue di dermaga, Sabtu subuh. Sampai jam enam lewat dua belas. Gue tahu karena dia kirim "ok".{w} Gue nggak dateng.
text.en: And then she waited for me at the pier, Saturday at dawn. Until twelve past six. I know because she texted "ok".{w} I didn't show up.

text.id: ...Jam lima pagi itu.
text.en: ...Five in the morning.

text.id: Makasih udah jujur. Gue masih kesel. Tapi makasih.
text.en: Thanks for being honest. I'm still mad. But thanks.

text.id: Gue pergi ke Bandung tanpa bilang. Itu aja.
text.en: I left for Bandung without telling her. That's all.

text.id: "Itu aja." Oke.
text.en: "That's all." Okay.

text.id: Lo tahu nggak, Kak Sekar juga selalu jawab "itu aja" kalau lagi bohong. Kalian mirip banget, nyebelin.
text.en: You know Sekar always says "that's all" when she's lying too? You two are so alike, it's annoying.

text.id: Matahari tenggelam di belakang crane-crane reklamasi. Langitnya oranye, lautnya abu-abu. Persis wallpaper HP Sekar.
text.en: The sun sets behind the reclamation cranes. Orange sky, grey sea. Exactly like the wallpaper on Sekar's phone.

text.id: Besok gue mau buka grup pendengarnya. Lo ikut baca?
text.en: Tomorrow I want to open the listener group. You'll read it with me?

text.id: Iya. Besok.
text.en: Yeah. Tomorrow.
